paper.title: From Corpora to Co-Evolving Capabilities: Capability-Centric Data Design for Generalist Image Generation
paper.abstract: Large-scale image generation has benefited from advances in data scale, quality, rebalancing, and recaptioning, yet conventional pipelines typically optimize task-specific datasets in isolation. A central challenge is not only how to curate each task-specific corpus, but also how to organize heterogeneous supervision according to the dependencies among generative capabilities. summary.core_problem: 这篇工作要解决的不是“如何再堆更多图像数据”，而是更难也更接近基座训练的问题：当一个通用图像生成模型同时需要学会 T2I、图像编辑、知识关联、文本渲染、结构化生成等多种能力时，训练数据应该如何按能力依赖关系来组织，而不是按任务孤立构建。作者认为，传统数据管线把 image-caption、editing pairs、知识图文样本分别优化，忽略了能力之间的前置关系和可迁移性，导致监督重复、覆盖低效、课程顺序不合理。论文的核心问题，就是如何把 heterogeneous supervision 重新组织成一个 capability-centric 的数据基础设施，让不同能力沿着依赖顺序共同生长。
summary.importance: 这篇工作与预训练研究的相关性明显高于一般图像生成数据论文，因为它讨论的不是单一数据集质量，而是数据组织原则、能力分解、课程调度和主动回流修正。这些问题与 LLM 预训练里的 data mixture、curriculum、mid-train / continual training、能力导向采样非常接近。它的贡献更偏系统设计和数据方法学，而不是单个算法模块。量级上，如果全文实验扎实，这类工作对多模态基座训练的启发会比“再做一次 recaptioning”更大：它提出的是一种把数据视为能力图谱而非样本池的训练观。
summary.technical_approach:
技术方案由两部分组成：capability-specific data pipeline 和 capability-aligned curriculum scheduling。

先看数据管线。作者没有把所有样本混成一个大池子统一清洗，而是设计了三个可互操作的数据引擎。

第一是 T2I data engine，目标是建立广覆盖的 text-image grounding。全文提到它会做概念覆盖扩展、长尾重平衡、多粒度 caption 对齐，以及 dense caption 构造。这里的关键不是单纯提高 caption 质量，而是让 T2I 数据承担“概念底座”的角色，为后续结构化生成、文本渲染和编辑提供可迁移的视觉词汇与语义对齐。

第二是 image-editing data engine。作者把编辑监督视为多种操作类型的组合，因此不是只收集 source-target pairs，而是为不同编辑类型设计专门构造流程，同时从自然相关图像中挖掘真实关联，并用专家生成样本补足稀缺编辑类型。更重要的是，编辑指令在词汇和描述结构上与 T2I caption 对齐，这样编辑任务可以复用 T2I 已学到的概念表示，而不必在编辑数据里重复覆盖全部视觉概念。

第三是 knowledge-grounded data engine。它通过知识图谱引导的数据获取，把视觉模式与命名实体、结构化知识关联起来。这个设计针对的是一般图像生成模型常见的知识薄弱问题：模型能画出“像某物”的图，但未必能稳定绑定实体、属性和关系。

再看课程调度。作者提出五阶段 curriculum，沿能力依赖顺序逐步扩展训练混合。起点是大规模 T2I，用来建立基础视觉语义对齐和基本生成先验；随后加入结构复杂、知识相关、文本密集的样本，发展结构构图、知识绑定和文本渲染；在 T2I prior 稳定后，再引入 editing data，学习 reference preservation 和 controlled transformation；之后通过 continual training 与 SFT，把 mixture 转向更小、更平衡、更精细的数据子集，并让图像分辨率随内容复杂度提升。这里有四个共同演化轴：任务组成、视觉概念分布、数据质量、图像分辨率。

全文里另一个值得注意的点是 active refinement loop。课程不是一次性写死，而是通过 capability-aware evaluation 把失败模式映射回对应数据引擎，做 targeted retrieval、expert construction、resampling，再把修正后的数据重新注入后续训练。这使它更像一个闭环数据系统，而不是静态配方。

与常见做法相比，这篇工作的区别不在于某个过滤器或 captioner 更强，而在于它把“数据样本”提升为“能力单元”，把“任务数据集”改写成“可迁移监督源”。
summary.experiments:
题面给出的全文片段主要覆盖引言，缺少完整实验表格和具体数字，因此不能虚构参数量、样本规模或精确提升幅度。能从全文叙述中明确提炼出的实验主线有三条。

第一，作者应当评估 capability-specific engines 的独立贡献与互补性，也就是 T2I、editing、knowledge-grounded 三类监督分别带来什么能力增益，以及联合训练是否优于把任务数据孤立构建后直接混合。若实验设计完整，最值得看的是：文本渲染、知识绑定、复杂结构生成、编辑保持度这几类能力是否出现明显迁移收益。

第二，作者强调 curriculum 的依赖顺序，因此实验里大概率会比较 capability-aligned schedule 与固定混合、随机混合、任务独立训练等基线。这里真正重要的不是最终单点分数，而是训练收敛速度、能力出现顺序，以及后期加入 editing / CT / SFT 后是否更稳定。

第三，active refinement loop 应该会通过 failure-driven data augmentation 或 targeted resampling 展示闭环收益。若论文给出案例，建议重点看哪些失败能通过回流修正，哪些失败则说明能力分解仍不充分。

从研究判断看，这篇工作的实验价值主要在“组织原则是否成立”。如果结果只是常规地证明更多高质量数据更好，那信息量有限；如果它能证明按能力依赖组织数据，比按任务堆数据更高效、更可迁移，那就有更强的方法学意义。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读时先抓住两个问题：作者如何定义 capability，以及这些 capability 之间的依赖关系是否有可操作的证据。Introduction 里关于 T2I 先于 editing、简单内容先于复杂结构、概念覆盖可跨任务迁移的论证，是理解整篇文章的入口。

接着看三个 data engine 的具体构造。重点不是数据量，而是每个引擎负责补哪类监督缺口、如何与其他引擎共享视觉词汇和标注规范。若正文有示意图或案例表，优先看这些，因为它们最能说明“specialized yet interoperable”到底怎么落地。

然后看五阶段 curriculum 和 active refinement loop。建议留意四个演化轴——任务组成、概念分布、质量、分辨率——是否真的联动，而不是口头描述。若有训练曲线或阶段切换实验，这部分最值得看。

最后看评测设计。若评测只是常规图像生成指标，阅读收益会下降；若作者构造了 capability-aware evaluation，把失败模式映射回数据引擎，那部分更有方法学价值。作为 skim 级阅读，30 到 40 分钟可以抓住主线；若你做多模态预训练数据系统，建议把数据引擎定义、课程表和失败回流机制一起细读。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper is not asking how to simply collect more image data. It asks a more foundational question: when training a generalist image generator that must acquire text-to-image generation, image editing, knowledge grounding, text rendering, and structured composition, how should data be organized according to capability dependencies rather than task silos? The authors argue that conventional pipelines optimize image-caption data, editing pairs, and knowledge-linked samples largely in isolation, which ignores transfer structure between capabilities and leads to redundant supervision and weak curricula. The core problem is how to build a capability-centric data infrastructure so that heterogeneous supervision supports co-evolving capabilities instead of fragmented tasks.
summary_en.importance: This is more relevant to pretraining research than a typical image-generation data paper because it is about data organization principles, capability decomposition, curriculum scheduling, and feedback-driven refinement. Those questions are close to LLM concerns such as data mixture design, curriculum, continual pretraining, and capability-targeted sampling. The contribution is mainly methodological and infrastructural rather than a single algorithmic trick. If the experimental evidence is strong, the paper matters because it treats data as a capability graph rather than a flat sample pool, which is a useful lens for multimodal foundation-model training.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The framework has two main parts: a capability-specific data pipeline and a capability-aligned curriculum schedule.

On the data side, the authors build three specialized but interoperable engines instead of throwing all samples into one global pool.

The first is a T2I data engine for broad text-image grounding. It expands concept coverage, rebalances long-tail distributions, aligns captions at multiple granularities, and uses dense captions where needed. The important design choice is that T2I data is treated as the conceptual base layer. It is not only for standalone text-to-image quality; it is meant to provide reusable visual vocabulary and semantic alignment for later capabilities such as structured generation, text rendering, and editing.

The second is an image-editing data engine. Rather than collecting generic source-target pairs only, the paper describes specialized pipelines for different edit types, mining realistic associations from naturally related images, and using expert-generated examples for sparse edit categories. A key interoperability choice is that editing instructions are aligned with T2I captions in vocabulary and descriptive structure. This allows editing supervision to reuse concepts already learned from T2I data instead of duplicating full concept coverage inside editing datasets.

The third is a knowledge-grounded data engine. It links visual patterns to named entities and structured knowledge through knowledge-graph-guided acquisition. This targets a common weakness in image generators: they may produce plausible imagery without reliably binding entities, attributes, and relations.

On the curriculum side, the paper proposes a five-stage schedule that follows the dependency order of capability acquisition. Training starts with large-scale T2I data to establish broad visual-semantic alignment and a basic generative prior. It then adds structurally complex, knowledge-grounded, and text-rich examples to develop composition, knowledge grounding, and text rendering. Once the T2I prior is stable, editing data is introduced to learn reference preservation and controlled transformation. Later continual training and supervised fine-tuning shift the mixture toward smaller, more balanced, and more refined subsets, while image resolution increases with content complexity. The schedule evolves jointly along four axes: task composition, visual concept distribution, data quality, and image resolution.

A notable systems idea is the active refinement loop. The schedule is not fixed once and for all. Capability-aware evaluation maps observed failures back to the relevant data engine, which then performs targeted retrieval, expert construction, or resampling. The refined data is fed back into later training mixtures. This makes the proposal a closed-loop data system rather than a static recipe.

Compared with standard data-pipeline work, the novelty is not a better filter or captioner in isolation. The novelty is the shift from task datasets to transferable supervision sources organized around capability dependencies.
summary_en.experiments:
The provided full-text excerpt is mostly from the introduction, so it does not expose the full result tables or exact numbers. It would be unsafe to invent model sizes, corpus sizes, or precise gains. Still, the experimental logic is clear from the paper’s framing.

First, the paper should test the independent and complementary value of the three data engines. The key question is whether T2I, editing, and knowledge-grounded supervision each improve distinct capabilities, and whether joint capability-oriented training is better than simply mixing task-specific datasets built in isolation. The most informative outcomes would be gains in text rendering, knowledge binding, complex composition, and edit faithfulness.

Second, because the paper emphasizes dependency-aware curriculum, an important comparison is likely between the proposed staged schedule and baselines such as fixed mixtures, random mixtures, or task-isolated training. What matters here is not only final quality but also convergence speed, emergence order of capabilities, and stability after introducing editing, continual training, and SFT.

Third, the active refinement loop should be evaluated through failure-driven data augmentation or targeted resampling. If the paper includes case studies, the useful question is which failure modes can be repaired by routing them back to the right data engine, and which ones reveal that the capability decomposition is still incomplete.

The real value of the experiments is whether they validate the organizational principle. If the results only show that more curated data helps, the contribution is limited. If they show that organizing data by capability dependencies is more sample-efficient or more transferable than organizing by task silos, the paper becomes much more interesting.
summary_en.reading_guide:
For a skim, start with how the paper defines capabilities and the dependency structure between them. The argument that T2I grounding should precede editing, and that simpler content should precede complex structure, is the conceptual entry point.

Then read the sections describing the three data engines. Focus less on raw scale and more on what supervision gap each engine fills, and how annotation conventions and visual vocabulary are shared across engines. Any diagrams or concrete examples are likely more informative than high-level prose.

Next, read the five-stage curriculum and the active refinement loop. Pay attention to whether the four evolving axes—task composition, concept distribution, quality, and resolution—are actually operationalized rather than described abstractly. Training curves or stage-transition ablations would be especially useful.

Finally, inspect the evaluation design. If the evaluation is only standard image-generation benchmarking, the methodological value is lower. If the paper includes capability-aware evaluation that maps failures back to data engines, that is the part worth studying carefully. For a skim-level read, 30 to 40 minutes should be enough. If you work on multimodal pretraining data systems, the data-engine definitions, curriculum schedule, and failure-feedback loop deserve a closer read.

recommendation.zh: 这篇不是 LLM，但它把 data mixture 从“按任务拼盘”改成“按能力依赖调度”，这个 prior 值得迁到多模态和 reasoning pretrain；先看数据引擎设计和 curriculum 章节。
recommendation.en: Not an LLM paper, but it reframes data mixture from task buckets to capability dependency scheduling; that prior is worth porting to multimodal and reasoning pretraining. Read the data-engine and curriculum sections first.

paper.title: Understanding Curriculum Learning in Large Language Models via Cross-Difficulty Optimization Dynamics
paper.abstract: Curriculum learning has been widely adopted in the post-training of large language models by organizing training data from easy to hard. However, its effectiveness varies substantially across reasoning tasks, suggesting that no single curriculum is universally optimal and raising a fundamental question: what determines when curriculum learning works? In this paper, we answer this question by analyzing the optimization dynamics induced by different curriculum schedules. We show that the transfer

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作讨论 LLM 推理 SFT 中的课程学习为什么有时有效、有时失效。核心问题不是再提出一个固定的 easy-to-hard 排序，而是解释不同难度数据之间的优化相互作用如何决定数据调度的效果。
summary.importance: 对预训练和后训练的数据调度都有启发。它把课程学习从“按难度排序”的经验规则，转成“不同数据子集梯度更新是否互相帮助”的优化问题。这个视角可以迁移到预训练数据 mixture、annealing、continued pretraining 和推理数据合成后的采样策略中。贡献量级属于机制解释加轻量自适应采样方法，不是新的基座训练范式。
summary.technical_approach: 方法先把训练集按难度分桶，然后研究在难度 j 上做一步更新，会怎样影响难度 i 上的 loss。基于一阶近似，更新带来的跨难度收益主要由不同难度 loss 梯度之间的内积或对齐程度决定。如果一个难度上的梯度能降低另一个难度的 loss，就形成正迁移；如果抬高对方 loss，就是干扰。论文将这种关系形式化为 Relative Transfer，用来刻画跨难度知识迁移。基于该指标，作者提出 Transfer-aware Dynamic Curriculum Sampling, TDCS。TDCS 不固定遵循 easy-to-hard，而是在训练过程中估计不同难度之间的迁移收益，并据此动态调整采样分布。与传统 curriculum、random、mix 的区别在于，它把采样权重绑定到当前优化状态，而不是绑定到预定义难度顺序。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 Sudoku、KodCode 和 iGSM，分别对应逻辑推理、代码生成和数学推理。数据按自然难度划分：Sudoku 和 KodCode 分为 4 个难度，iGSM 分为 5 个难度。初步结果显示，固定课程学习并不稳定：Curriculum 在 Sudoku 上最好，Random 在 KodCode 上最好，Mix 在 iGSM 上最好；iGSM 的最优调度还会随训练阶段变化。论文进一步报告 TDCS 在多个推理 benchmark、不同模型规模和 self-improvement 设置中优于固定调度策略。给出的正文片段没有包含表格中的具体准确率、模型参数量和数据规模，因此不适合补写精确数字。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 20 到 30 分钟。优先看 Empirical Observation 中的 Table 2 和 Figure 1，那里说明固定 curriculum 的不稳定性。然后看 Optimization Analysis 中 Relative Transfer 的定义和一阶推导，重点判断该指标是否只是梯度相似度的重命名，还是确实能预测调度收益。最后看 TDCS 的采样规则和 self-improvement 实验。值得深挖的是 Relative Transfer 的估计成本、噪声敏感性，以及它在大规模预训练 mixture 中是否可用。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper asks why curriculum learning helps some LLM reasoning fine-tuning runs but hurts or becomes neutral in others. The focus is not another fixed easy-to-hard schedule, but the optimization interaction between difficulty buckets.
summary_en.importance: The main value is a training-data scheduling lens that is useful beyond reasoning SFT. It reframes curriculum learning as a question of whether gradient updates from one data subset improve or interfere with other subsets. That idea is relevant to pretraining data mixtures, annealing schedules, continued pretraining, and sampling policies for synthetic reasoning data. The contribution is best viewed as a mechanism study plus an adaptive sampler, not a new foundation-model training paradigm.
summary_en.technical_approach: The method partitions examples into difficulty levels and analyzes how one optimization step on level j changes the loss on level i. Under a first-order approximation, the cross-difficulty effect is governed by the alignment between the corresponding loss gradients. Positive alignment implies transfer; negative alignment implies interference. The paper formalizes this interaction as Relative Transfer. It then proposes Transfer-aware Dynamic Curriculum Sampling, or TDCS, which estimates transfer relations during training and adjusts the sampling distribution over difficulty levels. This differs from standard curriculum, random sampling, and mixed schedules because the sampling weights depend on the current optimization state rather than a fixed difficulty order.
summary_en.experiments: The empirical study uses Sudoku, KodCode, and iGSM, covering logical reasoning, code generation, and mathematical reasoning. Sudoku and KodCode are split into 4 difficulty levels, while iGSM is split into 5. The preliminary comparison shows that no fixed schedule is consistently best: Curriculum wins on Sudoku, Random wins on KodCode, and Mix wins on iGSM. The iGSM curves also suggest that the best schedule changes over training. The paper further reports that TDCS outperforms fixed schedules across multiple reasoning benchmarks, model scales, and self-improvement settings. The provided full-text excerpt does not include exact accuracies, parameter counts, or data sizes, so precise numerical claims should not be added.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim in 20 to 30 minutes. Start with Table 2 and Figure 1 in the empirical section, since they motivate the failure of fixed curricula. Then read the Relative Transfer definition and the first-order derivation in the optimization analysis. The main point to check is whether the metric gives predictive signal beyond simple gradient similarity. Finally, inspect the TDCS sampling rule and the self-improvement experiments. The most useful follow-up questions are its estimation cost, sensitivity to noisy gradients, and whether the same idea can scale to pretraining data mixtures.

recommendation.zh: 把“课程有效性”落到可测的跨难度迁移指标上，比拍脑袋排课强；先读 Relative Transfer 定义和 TDCS 更新规则，重点看它是否优于简单 loss reweight。
recommendation.en: It grounds curriculum success in a measurable cross-difficulty transfer signal; read the Relative Transfer definition + TDCS update, and verify it beats trivial loss-based reweighting.

paper.title: On the Fragility of Self-Improving Agents: Variance, Task Order, and Underspecification
paper.abstract: Memory-based self-improving agents--those that learn from an online stream of tasks and improve over time by maintaining a textual memory bank--have shown great promise in recent literature. However, the reliability aspects of these methods have been critically overlooked. In this work, we conduct a comprehensive re-evaluation of two memory-based methods, broadening the scope of evaluation along two axes: (1) including multiple runs to quantify variance, and (2) randomly shuffling the tasks to i

summary.core_problem: 记忆型 self-improving agent 在在线任务流中会把过去经验写入文本记忆，但它们的收益对随机性、任务顺序和任务描述不充分高度敏感，单次评测容易给出不稳定结论。
summary.importance: 这篇工作不是预训练方法论文，但对 post-train、agent eval 和持续学习接口有直接警示。它指出，许多“自我改进”结果可能混入了隐藏 curriculum、单次运行噪声和错误记忆累积。对基座研究员的价值在于评测方法：如果训练或评测系统允许模型把错误经验写入长期状态，那么方差、顺序效应和环境约束说明必须被纳入协议，否则很难判断方法是否真的提升了能力。
summary.technical_approach: 论文重新评估两类代表性文本记忆方法：Agent Workflow Memory 和 ReasoningBank。评估做了两项关键改变。第一，使用更强的底座模型和 agent harness，建立更强基线。第二，不只跑单次结果，而是做多次运行来估计方差，并随机打乱任务顺序来测试 online stream 的顺序敏感性。随后作者手工检查 agent 写入的记忆，发现两类主要问题：环境 underspecification 和任务 underspecification。前者指记忆生成器不知道浏览器环境的真实约束，例如建议调用 API 或执行代码，但这些动作不可用。后者指任务描述含糊导致模型误解、过度推理，并把错误经验写入记忆。缓解方法是在记忆构造时加入更多上下文，例如环境反馈、任务 rubric，并修改 prompt 以明确环境限制。
summary.experiments: 实验覆盖 WebArena、VisualWebArena 和 SCUBA 三个网页交互 benchmark。关键数字包括：在 WebArena GitLab 子集 180 个任务上，无记忆基线的最好与最差运行有 4.4% 绝对性能差；加入 ReasoningBank 后，这个差距扩大到 7.8%，说明 self-improving loop 会放大评测噪声。任务顺序也很关键：默认顺序下 ReasoningBank 平均提升 1.5%，但随机打乱任务顺序后平均下降 4.5%。加入环境反馈、任务 rubric 和更清晰环境说明后，能够弥合 shuffled setting 中 31% 的性能退化，但仍有明显剩余差距。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读建议 25–35 分钟。先看 Introduction 中的两个核心实验轴：multiple runs 和 shuffled task order。再看 Background，确认 AWM 与 ReasoningBank 如何写入和检索文本记忆。实验部分重点看 WebArena GitLab 的方差结果、默认顺序与随机顺序的对比，以及缓解实验。手工分析记忆错误的部分也值得看，因为它解释了为什么简单增加记忆不一定带来稳定收益。对预训练研究者来说，可以把它当成在线学习评测协议的反例库，而不是 agent 方法改进论文。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies why memory-based self-improving agents are fragile: their apparent gains can depend strongly on run-to-run variance, task order, and underspecified task or environment descriptions.
summary_en.importance: This is not a pretraining-method paper, but it is relevant to post-training, agent evaluation, and continual-learning interfaces. It shows that reported self-improvement can be confounded by hidden curricula, single-run noise, and accumulated erroneous memories. For foundation-model research, the useful lesson is methodological: any system that writes model-generated experience into long-lived state must be evaluated under multiple seeds or runs, randomized task streams, and explicit environment constraints.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work re-evaluates two representative text-memory methods, Agent Workflow Memory and ReasoningBank. It strengthens the baseline by upgrading the underlying language model and the agent harness. It then expands the evaluation protocol along two axes: repeated runs to measure variance, and random task shuffling to test sensitivity to the online task stream. The authors manually inspect generated memories and identify two failure sources. Environment underspecification causes the memory writer to recommend actions that are plausible but not executable in the browser-only setting, such as using APIs or running code. Task underspecification leads to misunderstanding, overthinking, and wrong lessons that are stored and reused. The mitigation adds more context during memory construction, including environment feedback, task rubrics, and clearer prompt-level environment specifications.
summary_en.experiments: The evaluation uses WebArena, VisualWebArena, and SCUBA. On the 180-task WebArena GitLab subset, the no-memory baseline already has a 4.4 percentage-point gap between the best and worst runs. With ReasoningBank, the gap grows to 7.8 points, indicating that the self-improvement loop can amplify noise. Task order has a larger effect: under the default order, ReasoningBank improves average performance by 1.5 points, while under randomly shuffled orders it degrades performance by 4.5 points. The proposed context and prompt interventions recover 31% of the degradation in the shuffled setting, but a substantial gap remains.
summary_en.reading_guide: A 25–35 minute skim is appropriate. Read the introduction for the two evaluation axes: repeated runs and shuffled task order. Then check the background to understand how AWM and ReasoningBank write and retrieve textual memories. In the experiments, focus on the WebArena GitLab variance numbers, the default-order versus shuffled-order comparison, and the mitigation study. The manual memory analysis is useful because it explains why adding memory can reduce robustness. For pretraining-oriented readers, the paper is most useful as a cautionary evaluation study for online learning systems rather than as a new agent architecture.

recommendation.zh: 对 Agent 评估协议的批判性反思，指出了方差和任务顺序（隐式 curriculum）对结果的巨大影响，提醒我们在看 Agent 论文时要警惕 setup 不干净的问题。
recommendation.en: A critical reflection on Agent evaluation protocols, pointing out the massive impact of variance and task order (implicit curriculum) on results, reminding us to be wary of unclean setups when reading Agent papers.

paper.title: A Declarative-Procedural Perspective on Expert Routing in Bilingual Mixture-of-Experts Language Models
paper.abstract: We investigate whether Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models develop linguistically structured expert routing during bilingual language acquisition. Inspired by the Declarative-Procedural framework, we analyze lexical, grammatical, and syntactic processing in a decoder-only English-German MoE Transformer trained under sequential language exposure. We construct a probe-based validation set and extract token-level routing distributions to quantify category-dependent specialisation using mutual

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究双语 MoE 语言模型在语言学习过程中，专家路由是否会形成可解释的语言学分工，以及课程式双语暴露是否有助于这种分化。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究员的价值主要在于 MoE 路由分析，而不是方法本身。它试图把 lexical/grammatical/syntactic 类别与 expert routing 联系起来，属于机制分析类工作。贡献偏分析，不是训练范式突破。
summary.technical_approach: 作者训练一个英德 decoder-only MoE Transformer，比较 sequential curriculum 与 mixed bilingual training 两种暴露方式；然后构造 probe-based validation set，提取 token-level routing distribution，用 mutual information、routing entropy 和 Jensen-Shannon distance 衡量不同语言学类别上的专家专门化程度。
summary.experiments: 摘要给出关键数字：课程训练模型在第 5 层的峰值互信息为 0.1148，而无课程的混合训练基线在同层达到 0.2599，整体专门化更强。实验规模看起来不大，且只覆盖英德双语。结论更像一个小规模现象观察，外推到大规模生产级 MoE 需要谨慎。
summary.authors_note: 机构为印度 Chennai 的 Sri Sivasubramaniya Nadar College of Engineering。暂无可确认的知名作者或成熟大模型团队背景。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies whether bilingual MoE language models develop linguistically structured expert routing, and whether sequential curriculum exposure helps such specialization emerge.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance is mainly in MoE routing analysis rather than method innovation. It connects lexical, grammatical, and syntactic categories to expert routing behavior, making it a mechanism paper rather than a pretraining recipe contribution.
summary_en.technical_approach: The authors train an English-German decoder-only MoE Transformer under two regimes: sequential curriculum exposure and mixed bilingual training. They build a probe-based validation set and analyze token-level routing distributions using mutual information, routing entropy, and Jensen-Shannon distance to quantify category-dependent specialization.
summary_en.experiments: The abstract reports the main result: the curriculum model peaks at mutual information 0.1148 in layer 5, while the no-curriculum mixed-data baseline reaches 0.2599 at the same layer, showing stronger aggregate specialization. The setup appears small-scale and limited to English-German, so the result should be treated as a localized observation rather than a robust large-scale MoE law.
summary_en.authors_note: The affiliation is Sri Sivasubramaniya Nadar College of Engineering in Chennai. No widely recognized marquee author or major foundation-model lab is evident from the metadata.

recommendation.zh: 结论有点逆着“课程更利于结构化路由”的直觉，但规模明显偏小；只看互信息曲线和 layer-5 结果，当作 MoE 路由弱信号，不要据此改 recipe。
recommendation.en: The result pushes against the intuition that curriculum should yield cleaner routing, but the setup is small. Read the MI curves and the layer-5 comparison as a weak MoE signal, not as a recipe-changing result.

paper.title: Rethinking Normalization Placement for LLMs: Post-Norm under Curriculum Depth Growing
paper.abstract: Pre-norm is the standard normalization placement in modern Transformers because it facilitates joint optimization of full-depth models. We ask whether this preference persists when depth is introduced through a curriculum. In curriculum depth growth, each appended block receives the boundary representation produced by a trained prefix, making normalization placement relevant to forward conditioning. We therefore test whether placement and training curriculum interact. In a controlled distillatio

summary.core_problem: 现代Transformer普遍采用pre-norm归一化位置，这一选择是基于全深度端到端联合训练的优化经验形成的。在课程式深度增长范式（先训练浅层模型，后续训练阶段逐步追加新的网络块）下，pre-norm与post-norm的相对优劣尚未得到系统验证，尤其是归一化位置对跨块边界传递的表示分布的影响，此前未被纳入考量。
summary.importance: 该结论直接关联模型生长、持续预训练、分阶段深度扩展这类训练流程的设计。现有实践默认沿用全量联合训练下的pre-norm配置，但训练范式改变后，归一化位置的最优选择会发生变化，这一发现为非端到端联合训练的场景（包括渐进式模型扩参、块堆叠蒸馏、持续学习中的深度扩展）提供了具体的训练配置参考。
summary.technical_approach: 工作将课程式深度增长重新建模为逐块继承式初始化过程，在该场景下，归一化的作用不再仅仅是支撑全网络的梯度传播，还决定了已训练前缀模型传递给新追加块的边界表示分布特性。pre-norm仅在每个子层前执行归一化，不会显式归一化跨块边界的残差流输出；post-norm在每次残差更新后执行归一化，能够让块边界的表示尺度保持更稳定。研究以Qwen3-8B为固定教师模型，采用可扩展深度的9层块堆叠学生模型开展对照蒸馏实验，严格保证两种归一化配置的参数量一致，对比联合训练、课程深度增长两种流程下的验证交叉熵差异，同时通过块移除分析、块边界激活尺度统计、匹配训练token数的联合训练对照实验排除混淆变量。
summary.experiments: 在严格控制变量的蒸馏设置下，联合训练时pre-norm与post-norm的验证CE差异仅为0.0004，性能几乎无差别；在课程式深度增长流程下，post-norm比pre-norm的验证CE低0.0328，提升幅度比联合训练下的差异大一个数量级。控制实验显示，匹配学生有效层训练token数的联合训练结果仍差于课程增长下的post-norm，排除了“提升来自更多训练计算量”的解释。块边界激活诊断表明，post-norm的残差尺度在深度增长过程中保持稳定，pre-norm则会出现持续的尺度漂移，与之前提出的前向条件机制假设一致。
summary.reading_guide: 这是一篇短篇幅实证研究，重点关注方法部分对两种归一化方式在块边界行为差异的分析、控制实验设计（尤其是排除计算量混淆的部分）、激活尺度的诊断结果，核心内容约20分钟可读完。无需纠结蒸馏设置的具体工程细节，核心可迁移结论是“最优归一化位置依赖于训练过程中深度的引入方式”，对于开展渐进式模型扩展、持续预训练、MoE层扩展相关工作的研究者，可在自有训练流程中复现验证该效应。

summary_en.core_problem: Pre-norm is the de facto normalization placement for modern Transformers, a preference derived from optimization experience in end-to-end full-depth joint training. The relative performance of pre-norm and post-norm has not been systematically tested under curriculum depth growing, a training regime where training starts with a shallow model and new blocks are appended in sequential phases. In particular, the effect of normalization placement on the representation distribution passed across block boundaries has been largely overlooked.
summary_en.importance: This finding has direct implications for training pipelines involving model growth, continual pretraining, and staged depth expansion. The default choice of pre-norm, while optimal for full joint training, is not universally optimal across training regimes. The result provides concrete recipe guidance for non-end-to-end training scenarios including progressive model scaling, block-stacked distillation, and depth expansion during continual learning.
summary_en.technical_approach: The work reframes curriculum depth growing as a block-wise inherited initialization process, where normalization serves not only to stabilize gradient propagation across the full stack, but also to shape the forward distribution passed from trained prefix blocks to newly appended blocks. Pre-norm applies normalization only before each sub-layer and does not explicitly normalize residual stream outputs across block boundaries, while post-norm applies normalization after every residual update, delivering more stable representation scale at block boundaries. The study uses a frozen Qwen3-8B as the teacher, with a 9-layer expandable block-stacked student for controlled distillation, keeping parameter counts identical across normalization variants. It compares validation cross-entropy for pre-norm and post-norm under both joint training and curriculum depth growth, and isolates the mechanism via block-removal analysis, block-boundary activation scale diagnostics, and a matched-token post-joint control to rule out confounding variables.
summary_en.experiments: In the controlled distillation setup, pre-norm and post-norm differ by only 0.0004 validation CE under joint training, effectively indistinguishable. Under curriculum depth growth, post-norm outperforms pre-norm by 0.0328 validation CE, an order of magnitude larger difference than observed in joint training. The control experiment, which matches the number of training tokens on active student layers for post-joint training, still underperforms post-norm under curriculum growth, ruling out extra training compute as the sole source of improvement. Block-boundary activation diagnostics show stable residual scale for post-norm across growth phases, while pre-norm exhibits progressive scale drift, consistent with the proposed forward-conditioning mechanism.
summary_en.reading_guide: This is a short empirical study. Focus on the analysis of how the two normalization placements differ in behavior at block boundaries, the control experiment design (especially the setup that rules out training compute as a confounder), and the activation scale diagnostic results. Core content can be read in roughly 20 minutes. There is no need to dwell on low-level engineering details of the distillation setup. The key takeaway—that optimal normalization placement depends on how depth is introduced during training—is particularly relevant for researchers working on progressive model scaling, continual pretraining, or MoE layer expansion, who may want to validate this effect in their own training pipelines.

recommendation.zh: 课程深度增长下post-norm显著优于pre-norm，和全深度训练结论相反，做渐进式训练或逐层蒸馏的可直接复现其实验设置，重点看Fig 2的排名交叉曲线。
recommendation.en: Post-norm significantly outperforms pre-norm under curriculum depth growing, contradicting full-depth training results. Teams doing progressive training or layer-wise distillation can directly replicate the setup, focus on Fig 2.

paper.title: Predicting Task Difficulty Without Rollouts
paper.abstract: Task difficulty dictates an agent's likelihood of success, and estimating it without rollouts means forecasting this directly from a task description before executing costly simulations in stateful environments. Reliable estimates would therefore allow environment designers to calibrate evaluation benchmarks and construct progressive training curricula. This becomes increasingly important as agents move into long-horizon domains, where empirical trial-and-error is a severe computational bottlene

summary.core_problem: 这篇工作研究的是一个评测与训练管线里的前置问题：在不做 rollouts、不运行完整 agent 交互的前提下，仅根据任务描述和少量静态元信息，能否预估一个 agent 任务有多难。作者关心的不是单个模型的 uncertainty 校准，而是跨 benchmark、跨 agent 配置地定义“任务难度”这一潜变量，并检验这种 ex ante 预测能否替代昂贵的实测试跑。问题之所以重要，是因为长时程 agent benchmark 的验证成本越来越高，很多任务一次评测就要消耗大量环境交互和模型调用；如果难度不能预估，benchmark 构造、课程学习和数据筛选都会变得很低效。
summary.importance: 对预训练研究的关联不是直接改进 base model，而是提供了一个和数据课程、评测设计、合成任务筛选都相关的工具视角。第一，它把 task difficulty 从“经验上觉得难”变成了可估计、可排序的量，这对构造 curriculum、挑选训练样本、控制 benchmark 覆盖度有现实意义。第二，论文提醒人们不要用 response-level AUC 这类看起来很高的指标误判难度预测能力，因为它可能只是在区分成功/失败样本，而没有真正学到 task-level 难度排序。第三，作者公开了一个跨 17 个 agent benchmark 的结果库，并用 IRT 建 difficulty target，这对后续做 agent scaling、benchmark contamination 分析、任务去重和难度分层采样都有参考价值。它更像一篇评测方法与数据资产论文，而不是预训练算法论文。
summary.technical_approach:
方法分两步。第一步，从已有 agent-task 成败记录中估计每个任务的 latent difficulty。作者把每次 trial 视作 Bernoulli 观测，构造一个部分观测的 agent×task 二值响应矩阵，然后用 1PL IRT（Rasch model）拟合每个 agent 的能力参数 θ_a 和每个任务的难度参数 β_t。这样定义难度有一个好处：它不是某个单一模型的通过率，而是在共享标尺上相对于多种 agent 能力共同估出来的，因此更适合跨 benchmark 比较。

第二步，用 rollout 前可获得的特征去预测 β_t。特征包括任务文本描述、环境与动作空间描述、元数据，以及作者特别强调的 entropy 等不需要完整交互即可得到的信号。论文还系统讨论了评估协议：如果用 response AUC，模型可能在样本级别上看起来预测得不错，但 task-level rank correlation 仍然很弱，因此作者主张用 Spearman ρ 这类排序指标来评估“是否真的学到了难度”。此外，论文做了 residual diagnostics：把预测难度与 IRT 估计难度的残差拿出来分析。正残差大的任务，往往是比文本表面看起来更难，原因可能是环境不可行、verifier 有问题、接口设计不合理；负残差大的任务，则可能因为训练数据熟悉、模板化、捷径存在而显得异常容易。这个诊断视角比单纯做一个回归器更有用。
summary.experiments:
数据规模是这篇论文最扎实的部分。主分析子集包含 17 个 benchmark、5230 个任务、497 个 agent 配置，这些配置来自 216 个模型和 90 个 scaffold；总语料库包含 415,470 条 agent-task outcome。任务类型覆盖 coding/SWE、function calling、web navigation、computer use、terminal、math、ML、cybersecurity 和 general-purpose suites，时间跨度从 2010 到 2026。每个 agent-task 对平均约 1.2 次 trial。

结果上，作者给出的核心数字是：在 K-fold 评估下，组合特征的 task difficulty 预测达到 Spearman ρ=0.399，且相对 baseline 的提升有统计显著性（p<0.001）；在 out-of-distribution 设置下，ρ=0.225。单一特征族里，entropy 最强。论文还指出 response AUC 可能偏乐观，即便 task difficulty 排序学得不好，AUC 仍然可以很高，因此 rank-based 指标更可信。更有信息量的是残差分析案例：一些任务被模型预测为不难，但真实 IRT 难度很高，最后发现是环境不可完成或 evaluator 失灵；另一些任务文本上看似复杂，实际却因数据熟悉或 shortcut 而容易。这说明 difficulty predictor 不只是一个打分器，还能帮助发现 benchmark 设计缺陷。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读时先看数据与目标定义，也就是 17 个 benchmark 如何统一成 agent×task 响应矩阵，以及为什么作者选 1PL IRT 而不是直接用平均成功率。这里决定了整篇论文是否站得住。然后看评估部分，重点理解作者为什么批评 response AUC，并把 task-level rank correlation 作为主指标。接着看 feature ablation，尤其是 entropy 为什么在单特征里表现最好，以及组合特征带来了什么增益。最后看 residual diagnostics 的案例分析，这部分最接近实际使用场景：它告诉你难度预测器能否帮助发现坏任务、脏 verifier 和 shortcut。预计 25–35 分钟可以读完主线；如果只想抓结论，看 §3 的 IRT 建模、§4/§5 的主结果和残差分析即可。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper studies a front-end problem in agent evaluation and training pipelines: can task difficulty be predicted before any rollout, using only task descriptions and static metadata, instead of running expensive agent-environment interactions? The target is not model-specific uncertainty calibration, but a benchmark-level notion of latent task difficulty that transfers across agent configurations and benchmark families. This matters because long-horizon agent benchmarks are becoming costly to validate, and without ex ante difficulty estimates it is hard to build calibrated evaluations, progressive curricula, or efficient task filters.
summary_en.importance: Its relevance to pretraining is indirect but real. Difficulty estimation can support curriculum construction, synthetic task selection, benchmark curation, and contamination analysis. The paper makes three useful points. First, it turns task difficulty from an informal intuition into an estimable latent variable that can be ranked across tasks. Second, it shows that response-level AUC can be misleadingly optimistic: a predictor may separate easy and hard responses without learning the actual ordering of task difficulty. Third, it releases a large multi-benchmark corpus and uses IRT-derived difficulty targets, which should be useful for future work on agent scaling, benchmark design, and difficulty-aware sampling. This is best viewed as an evaluation-method and data-asset paper rather than a pretraining-method paper.
summary_en.technical_approach:
The pipeline has two stages. First, the authors estimate latent task difficulty from observed agent-task outcomes. Each trial is treated as a Bernoulli observation, forming a partially observed binary response matrix over agents and tasks. They fit a one-parameter logistic IRT model, or Rasch model, with one scalar ability parameter θ_a per agent configuration and one scalar difficulty parameter β_t per task. This is preferable to raw pass rate because difficulty is inferred relative to a population of agents on a shared scale, making it more suitable for cross-benchmark comparison.

Second, they train predictors of β_t using only pre-rollout features. These include textual task descriptions, environment and action-space descriptions, metadata, and uncertainty-related signals such as entropy that can be obtained without full interaction. A major methodological contribution is the evaluation protocol. The paper argues that response AUC can look strong even when task-level difficulty estimates are poor, so it emphasizes rank-based metrics such as Spearman correlation for judging whether the predictor actually learns difficulty ordering. The residual analysis is also important: discrepancies between predicted and observed IRT difficulty are used diagnostically. Large positive residuals often indicate hidden hardness factors such as infeasible environments or broken evaluators, while large negative residuals may reveal familiarity, templating, or shortcuts.
summary_en.experiments:
The empirical foundation is substantial. The main analysis subset contains 5,230 tasks from 17 benchmarks, evaluated by 497 agent configurations built from 216 models and 90 scaffolds. The full corpus includes 415,470 agent-task outcomes. Domains span coding and SWE, function calling, web navigation, computer use, terminal tasks, math, ML, cybersecurity, and general-purpose suites. Task dates range from 2010 to 2026, and each agent-task pair has about 1.2 trials on average.

The headline numbers are straightforward. Under K-fold evaluation, the combined feature set reaches Spearman ρ = 0.399, significantly better than the baseline at p < 0.001. Under out-of-distribution evaluation, it reaches ρ = 0.225. Among single feature families, entropy performs best. The paper also shows that response AUC can remain high even when task-level difficulty ranking is weak, which supports the claim that rank-based evaluation is the more faithful metric. The residual case studies are especially useful: some tasks predicted to be moderate turn out to be much harder because the environment is infeasible or the verifier is faulty, while others that look difficult in text are actually easy due to familiarity or shortcuts. That makes the predictor useful not only for scoring tasks, but also for debugging benchmarks.
summary_en.reading_guide: For a skim, start with the target construction: how 17 heterogeneous benchmarks are unified into an agent-by-task response matrix, and why the authors use 1PL IRT instead of average success rate. That is the conceptual backbone. Then read the evaluation section carefully, especially the argument against relying on response AUC and the shift toward task-level rank correlation. After that, inspect the feature ablations, with special attention to why entropy is the strongest single feature family and what the combined features add. Finish with the residual diagnostics, since that is where the method becomes practically useful for benchmark design and task filtering. Around 25 to 35 minutes should be enough for the main thread. If time is short, focus on the IRT setup in Section 3 and the main results plus residual analysis in Sections 4 and 5.

recommendation.zh: 无rollout任务难度预测的实用结论，token熵信号可直接用于数据课程与推理计算分配，看§3特征分析即可
recommendation.en: Practical findings on rollout-free task difficulty prediction, the token entropy signal is directly usable for data curriculum and inference compute allocation, just read §3 feature analysis.

paper.title: CVPO: Enhancing LLM Reinforcement Learning Reasoning via Value-Variance Adaptation and Dynamic Curriculum Learning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning (RL) has emerged as an effective method for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs). However, existing methods suffer from insufficient precision in feedback on generated answer trajectories and exhibit the phenomenon of problem difficulty drift. To address these challenges, we propose CVPO - Curriculum-guided Value-Variance Policy Optimization. At the response trajectory level, we find that token-level value-variance correlates with exploratio

summary.core_problem: 在基于价值函数的 LLM 推理强化学习（PPO/VAPO 一类）里，(1) 轨迹层面的反馈/归因不够精细，尤其当同一题采样到的轨迹“全对或全错”时，优势函数缺少可区分的梯度信号；(2) 训练过程中题目相对难度随模型变强而漂移，固定采样/固定权重会把算力浪费在已变简单的题上，导致效率和上限受限。论文试图用“价值方差”刻画探索强度并据此调优势，同时用动态课程缓解难度漂移。
summary.importance: 对 pretrain↔posttrain 闭环里“RL 如何提供更稳定、更信息密度更高的训练信号”有启发：它把 value model 的不确定性（方差）显式引入优势估计与样本加权，属于在 PPO/价值法框架内改 credit assignment 与训练动态的工作。价值在于提供了一个可操作的信号（trajectory value-variance）来调节更新幅度与探索，而不是只靠 reward 形状或采样温度。局限是：从给出的全文片段看，理论推导偏上界分析，是否能稳定复现、对不同 reward 形态/不同基座是否一致，需要依赖完整实验部分验证。
summary.technical_approach:
方法由两层组成。
1) 轨迹层：Value-Variance Adaptation。先用 value model 在 token 级对轨迹状态 s_t 估计 V(s_t)，计算一条轨迹上 token-level value 的方差（或等价的 advantage 方差 proxy），把它当作“内禀随机性/探索强度”的度量：方差高表示生成更不确定、探索更活跃；方差低表示策略更僵硬。论文给出推导：在假设 ∥∇ log π(a|s)∥ 有界时，policy gradient 的范数上界与 advantage 的方差相关，从而 value-variance 可以界定单步更新幅度。基于此，设计 variance-aware 的优势调整：针对不同 reward 类型（例如稀疏的正确性奖励 vs 过程奖励/密集奖励），用方差对优势进行缩放或重加权，使“高不确定但潜在有用”的轨迹获得更合适的学习信号，同时抑制低信息的同质轨迹导致的无效更新。
2) 题目层：Dynamic Curriculum Learning。维护题目难度的动态估计（随训练阶段更新），按难度对题目加权/采样，避免 difficulty drift 后仍把大量 batch 分配给已变简单的题；让训练在每个阶段更集中于与当前能力匹配、且能推动边界的题目。
与 GRPO 的区别：GRPO 通过组内多轨迹 reward 平均来构造 advantage，弱化了 value model；CVPO 明确依赖 value model，并用“方差”进一步细化轨迹权重与更新幅度。与 VAPO 的区别：VAPO 强调 value model 带来更准的 credit assignment，CVPO 进一步把 value 的不确定性/波动当作调节信号，并补上题目级课程以对抗难度漂移。
summary.experiments:
给出的全文内容未包含实验设置与具体数字（模型规模、训练步数、数据/题库、对比方法、提升幅度、消融表格等），只能确认作者声称：在多个数学推理基准上优于其他领先方法，并通过消融验证两项改动（方差优势调整、动态课程）的贡献。需要在完整论文中核对：
- 是否在同一基座/同一采样预算下比较（尤其是 group size、采样温度、KL 约束、reward 计算方式）。
- value-variance 的计算细节（token 级 V 的来源、是否用 GAE、是否做归一化/截断）对稳定性的影响。
- curriculum 的难度估计指标与更新频率，以及是否引入分布偏移或遗忘。
- 对“全对/全错”同质轨迹场景，是否有定量展示梯度可分性提升（例如 advantage 分布、有效样本比例、更新范数/clip ratio）。
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（预计 20–30 分钟）：
- 先看 Methodology 里关于“value-variance 与更新上界”的推导，重点抓住它到底在界定什么量（更新范数、还是 surrogate objective 的变化），以及方差是对 V(s_t) 还是对 A_t 的统计。
- 再看算法伪代码/实现细节（如果有）：方差如何估计、如何进入 advantage、对不同 reward 类型的分支规则是什么。
- 最后看 curriculum 部分：难度度量、权重函数、以及训练过程中难度分布如何随时间演化。
- 如果实验部分完整，优先找：消融（只开方差/只开课程）、训练曲线（loss/return/clip fraction/KL）、以及对 shard/题目分布变化的鲁棒性。

summary_en.core_problem: Value-based RL for LLM reasoning (PPO/VAPO-style) faces (1) weak trajectory-level credit assignment when sampled trajectories for a prompt are homogeneous (all correct or all incorrect), yielding low-discriminability advantages; and (2) difficulty drift, where prompts become easier as the model improves, making fixed sampling/weighting inefficient and potentially capping performance. The paper proposes to use value-variance as a signal to adapt advantages and to apply a dynamic curriculum to track evolving difficulty.
summary_en.importance: Relevant to the pretrain–posttrain interface: it targets the quality and stability of RL training signals rather than changing the base model. The key idea is to treat uncertainty/variability in the value function along a trajectory as an actionable control knob for exploration and update magnitude, instead of relying solely on reward shaping or sampling temperature. The practical impact depends on whether the variance signal is robust across reward designs and base models; the provided content does not include enough experimental detail to confirm reproducibility and effect size.
summary_en.technical_approach:
CVPO has two components.
(1) Trajectory level: Value-Variance Adaptation. A value model estimates token-level V(s_t) along each generated trajectory. The variance of these values (or a closely related advantage-variance proxy) is used as an intrinsic randomness / exploration indicator: high variance implies more exploratory, low variance implies rigid generation. The paper sketches a bound showing the policy-gradient norm can be upper-bounded by a term involving advantage variance under a bounded ∥∇ log π∥ assumption, motivating variance-aware control of update magnitude. Based on this, CVPO modifies advantage computation by scaling/reweighting trajectories according to their value-variance, with different handling for different reward types (e.g., sparse correctness vs denser rewards), aiming to extract more informative gradients from otherwise homogeneous outcomes.
(2) Prompt level: Dynamic Curriculum Learning. It maintains a moving estimate of prompt difficulty and dynamically reweights/samples prompts to counter difficulty drift, allocating more training budget to prompts that remain challenging at the current stage.
Compared to GRPO, CVPO is explicitly value-based and goes beyond group reward averaging by injecting a variance signal into advantage shaping. Compared to VAPO, it adds an uncertainty-aware (variance-aware) advantage adjustment plus an explicit curriculum mechanism.
summary_en.experiments: The supplied full-text excerpt does not include concrete experimental numbers (model sizes, data/task sets, training budgets, baselines, gains, or ablations). The authors claim consistent improvements on multiple math reasoning benchmarks and ablations validating both variance adaptation and curriculum weighting. When checking the full paper, the critical points are: fairness of comparisons (sampling budget, group size, KL constraints), how value-variance is computed/normalized/clipped, whether curriculum induces distribution shift or forgetting, and whether they quantify the claimed benefit in homogeneous-trajectory regimes (advantage separability, effective sample ratio, update norms/clip fractions).
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (20–30 minutes):
- Read the derivation connecting value/advantage variance to an update bound; verify what is actually bounded and what assumptions are required.
- Locate the exact algorithmic definition: variance estimator, how it modifies advantages, and the branching logic for different reward types.
- Review the curriculum section: difficulty metric, weighting function, and how difficulty distribution evolves during training.
- If available, prioritize ablations (variance-only vs curriculum-only), training dynamics plots (return/KL/clip fraction), and robustness checks.

recommendation.zh: 值得看的是“value variance 能否作为更新强度代理”这个判断；先读理论段和课程权重消融，若 setup 不够干净，就把它当 GRPO/PPO 的局部修补而不是新范式。
recommendation.en: Read it for the claim that value variance can proxy update aggressiveness; check the theory section and curriculum ablations first, and treat it as a local PPO/GRPO patch unless the setup is unusually clean.

paper.title: Beyond Simply Environment Scaling: Designing Effective Environment Distributions for Multimodal Agent Learning
paper.abstract: Recent works train agents by constructing large-scale multimodal environment pools. However, we find that simply increasing the number of multimodal environments does not always benefit. We further analyze the limitations in current multimodal environment distributions through a series of experiments. Based on these findings, we study how to build more effective training environment distributions from two dimensions: **diversity** and **difficulty structure**. For diversity, we propose **Ability

summary.core_problem: 多模态智能体训练中，单纯扩大环境池规模无法稳定提升性能，甚至会因环境冗余、能力冲突和难度结构不合理导致性能下降；现有环境分布设计只关注单个环境的可执行性和奖励可靠性，未从多样性与难度结构两个维度系统优化训练分布。
summary.importance: 将预训练数据分布设计的思路迁移到多模态智能体的环境分布设计，明确了「环境规模≠训练收益」的关键判断，对后续基于动态环境的多模态基座训练、课程学习设计和数据/环境筛选策略有直接参考价值。
summary.technical_approach: 从多样性和难度结构两个维度重构环境分布：1) 多样性方面提出 Ability-aware Environment Selection (AES)，不使用任务描述等表层信号度量多样性，而是从智能体轨迹中分解出可复用的原子能力，为每个环境构建元能力画像；选择环境时最大化元能力覆盖度，同时通过画像相似度去重、基于梯度机制分析降低优化冲突。2) 难度结构方面提出 Hierarchical Difficulty Curriculum (HDC)，针对多模态智能体视觉状态提取和世界建模两个核心瓶颈，设计两层难度课程：外层逐步移除提供文本辅助信息的训练支架（harness weakening），内层在每个支架阶段按状态规模做常规课程学习；相比仅按状态规模定义难度的文本智能体方案，更贴合多模态场景的能力瓶颈。
summary.experiments: 基于已有工作构建统一的 200 个多模态环境池。控制实验显示：在固定计算预算下，增加环境类型数量不会单调提升性能，部分规模下性能反而下降；同一环境集合的多模态版本比文本-符号版本表现出更强的负迁移和梯度冲突。AES 选出的环境子集在使用更少环境的情况下超过全环境池训练的效果；HDC 相比直接训练和仅按规模的课程学习训练更稳定、性能更好；AES+HDC 在不同设置下平均相对收益为 143.2%。
summary.reading_guide: 重点阅读第 2 节的控制实验分析（环境规模非单调收益、多模态 vs 文本-符号的对比），理解问题本身比方法更关键；第 3 节 AES 的元能力画像构建和梯度冲突分析部分，第 4 节 HDC 的两层课程设计逻辑；附录 B 的实验设置细节。泛读为主，预计 40-60 分钟，核心是吸收「环境分布设计的两个维度」这一分析框架。

summary_en.core_problem: In multimodal agent training, simply scaling up the environment pool does not reliably improve performance, and can even degrade it due to environment redundancy, ability conflicts, and poorly structured difficulty schedules. Existing environment distribution designs only focus on per-environment executability and reward reliability, without systematically optimizing the training distribution along diversity and difficulty-structure dimensions.
summary_en.importance: This work transfers the design principles of pretraining data distribution to environment distribution for multimodal agents, and establishes the key observation that environment scale does not equal training gain. It provides direct reference for future multimodal foundation training on dynamic environments, curriculum design, and data/environment selection strategies.
summary_en.technical_approach: The environment distribution is redesigned along two axes: (1) For diversity, Ability-aware Environment Selection (AES) avoids surface-level diversity signals such as task descriptions. Instead, it decomposes agent trajectories into reusable atomic abilities and builds a meta-ability profile for each environment. Environment selection maximizes meta-ability coverage, removes redundancy via profile similarity, and mitigates optimization conflicts through mechanistic gradient analysis. (2) For difficulty structure, Hierarchical Difficulty Curriculum (HDC) targets the two unique bottlenecks of multimodal agents — visual state extraction and world modeling — with a two-level curriculum: the outer level progressively removes textual training scaffolds (harness weakening), and the inner level applies conventional state-scale curriculum within each harness stage. This design is better aligned with multimodal ability bottlenecks than text-agent schedules that define difficulty purely by state scale.
summary_en.experiments: A unified pool of 200 multimodal environments is built from prior work. Controlled experiments show that under fixed compute budget, increasing the number of environment types does not monotonically improve performance, and performance drops at certain scales. The multimodal version of the same environment set exhibits stronger negative transfer and gradient conflicts than its text-symbolic counterpart. The AES-selected subset outperforms training on the full pool while using fewer environments. HDC yields more stable training and better results than both direct training and scale-only curriculum. AES+HDC achieves an average relative gain of 143.2% across settings.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on Section 2 for controlled analyses (non-monotonic gain with environment scale, multimodal vs text-symbolic comparison) — understanding the problem is more critical than the method itself. Then read Section 3 for AES meta-ability profiling and gradient conflict analysis, and Section 4 for the two-level HDC design. Appendix B contains detailed experimental settings. Skim-level reading, 40-60 minutes; the main takeaway is the two-dimension framework for environment distribution design.

recommendation.zh: 指出了Agent训练中无脑堆环境数量的局限性，提出的基于能力感知和难度分级的课程学习策略对构建高质量Agent训练数据有参考价值。
recommendation.en: Points out the limitations of mindlessly scaling environments in agent training; the proposed curriculum learning strategies based on ability awareness and difficulty grading are valuable for constructing high-quality agent training data.

paper.title: Question Begets Question: Self-Evolving Curriculum for Reinforcement Fine-Tuning on Competition Mathematics
paper.abstract: Teaching a language model a skill it has not mastered is obstructed by three recurring difficulties: training data is scarce, ground-truth reasoning traces are usually unavailable, and models often exhibit an apparent ceiling beyond which additional data yields no further improvement. We study these difficulties in a controlled setting, fine-tuning Qwen2.5-Math-7B on competition mathematics (AIME), a task on which it initially solves only 5.6\% of problems (pass@1). To address data scarcity, we

summary.core_problem: 在困难技能学习中，训练数据稀缺、标准答案推理轨迹不可得，而且模型常在增加数据后出现性能平台期。论文以 Qwen2.5-Math-7B 在 AIME 竞赛数学上为受控场景，研究如何用合成数据和强化微调突破这一瓶颈。
summary.importance: 对后训练和数据课程设计有直接参考价值。核心发现不是“多合成数据”本身，而是合成数据的多样性、与当前模型能力的匹配度，以及课程中种子题目的选择。尤其值得注意的是，从“模型基本能做对”的近成功样本生成变体，比从最难失败样本学习更有效，这与常见的“从错误中学习”直觉不同。
summary.technical_approach: Question-begets-Question（QbQ）让教师模型把已有题目改写成探测相同底层技能的多样化变体，避免静态增强中的多样性坍缩。训练只使用题目和最终答案，通过 GRPO 做强化学习，不使用教师的逐步推理轨迹，因此模拟无 oracle reasoning 的场景，并减少蒸馏依赖。自演化课程运行 20 轮：先用 pass@16 评估当前 checkpoint 在上一轮合成题上的表现，将题目分为已掌握、基本能做对、偶尔做对、从未做对四档；然后以“基本能做对”的题目为种子生成变体；再用 GRPO 训练。每轮种子来自上一轮产物，而不是固定原始题集，从而持续适配模型当前能力。
summary.experiments: Qwen2.5-Math-7B 在 AIME 2025/2026 上的基线 pass@1 为 5.6%。在 1005 道带解答真题上，SFT 达到 9.5%，GRPO 达到 11.5%。用 GPT-5-mini 静态生成 5000 道合成题并与真题合并，仅达到 12.05%。仅用 6000 道 QbQ 合成题、不用真题即可达到 14.5%，但训练最后 30% 出现平台期。在相同数据和计算预算下，自演化课程将 pass@1 提升到 16.5%，20 轮后没有饱和迹象。消融显示从近成功题目播种持续优于从最难题目播种，并且模型能解决未训练过的更难题目。
summary.reading_guide: 建议用 30–45 分钟。重点看引言中对三个障碍的拆解、Figure 2 的平台期曲线，以及 QbQ 与自演化课程的流程。最值得深挖的是四档能力划分和“基本能做对”种子选择策略，以及对应的消融实验。数学任务只是载体，关键结论可迁移到其他 RL 数据课程和合成数据设计。

summary_en.core_problem: Learning a difficult skill is constrained by scarce training data, unavailable ground-truth reasoning traces, and apparent plateaus where more data no longer helps. The paper studies this in a controlled setting by fine-tuning Qwen2.5-Math-7B on AIME competition mathematics, a task the base model initially solves at only 5.6% pass@1.
summary_en.importance: The paper is relevant to post-training, synthetic data design, and RL curricula. Its main finding is not that synthetic data helps in the abstract, but that diversity and alignment with the model’s current capability matter. The counterintuitive result is that seeding new problems from near-successes—problems the model can mostly get right—works better than seeding from the hardest failures.
summary_en.technical_approach: Question-begets-Question (QbQ) has a teacher model transform existing problems into diverse variants that probe the same underlying skills, reducing the diversity collapse seen in static augmentation. Training uses GRPO with only problem statements and final answers, without teacher step-by-step reasoning traces, which models the no-oracle-reasoning setting and limits distillation. The self-evolving curriculum runs for 20 rounds: evaluate the current checkpoint on the previous round’s problems with pass@16, sort them into mastered, mostly correct, sometimes correct, and never correct bands; seed new variants from the mostly-correct problems; then train with GRPO. Because each round’s seeds come from the previous round’s generated problems rather than a fixed source set, the curriculum continuously tracks the model’s evolving ability.
summary_en.experiments: Qwen2.5-Math-7B starts at 5.6% pass@1 on AIME 2025/2026. On 1,005 real problems with solutions, SFT reaches 9.5% and GRPO reaches 11.5%. Adding 5,000 static synthetic problems from GPT-5-mini to the real data only reaches 12.05%. Training on 6,000 QbQ problems alone, without real problems, reaches 14.5%, but plateaus over the final 30% of training. Under the same data and compute budget, the self-evolving curriculum reaches 16.5% with no sign of saturation after 20 rounds. Ablations show that seeding from near-successes consistently outperforms seeding from the hardest problems, and the resulting model solves harder problems it was never trained on.
summary_en.reading_guide: Spend about 30–45 minutes. Focus on the introduction’s decomposition of the three obstacles, the plateau curve in Figure 2, and the QbQ plus self-evolving curriculum pipeline. The most important technical detail is the four-band evaluation and the choice to seed from mostly-correct problems, together with the corresponding ablations. Mathematics is the testbed; the curriculum lesson transfers more broadly to RL data selection and synthetic-data generation.

recommendation.zh: 读数据生成和 curriculum ablation；它更像 RLVR 数据分布实验，不是数学模型能力报告。
recommendation.en: Read the data-generation and curriculum ablations; this is a useful RLVR data-distribution study, not just a math fine-tuning result.

paper.title: Curriculum Matters: Data-Efficient Relational PFN Pretraining with Synthetic Data
paper.abstract: Relational Prior-Data Fitted Networks (PFNs) such as RDB-PFN approximate Bayesian inference over multi-table relational databases by pretraining on millions of synthetic tasks. We investigate three intertwined questions about this paradigm. First, can a structurally different synthetic generator PluRel substitute for RDB-PFN's prior? Second, how much does the order in which synthetic data is presented to the PFN affect downstream performance? Third, how much relational reasoning can a PFN acquir

summary.core_problem: 研究关系型Prior-Data Fitted Network（PFN）合成预训练中的三个核心问题：合成生成器可替代性、数据呈现顺序（课程）的影响、单表预训练的关系推理迁移能力
summary.importance: 验证了合成预训练下渐进式复杂度课程可带来数量级的数据效率提升，为低资源合成预训练提供了新的配方参考
summary.technical_approach: 使用PluRel合成数据生成器替代原有RDB-PFN的生成器，设计从7列到17列逐步增加schema复杂度的渐进式单表训练课程，对比随机顺序、无课程基线
summary.experiments: 在23个表格任务基准上，使用约13300个合成表（比RDB-PFN原有warmup数据量少45倍）即可达到0.703平均ROC-AUC，相同数据量下随机顺序训练效果显著更差

summary_en.core_problem: Investigates three core questions in synthetic pretraining for relational Prior-Data Fitted Networks: substitutability of synthetic generators, effect of training data order (curriculum), and relational reasoning transfer from single-table pretraining
summary_en.importance: Demonstrates that progressive complexity curriculum in synthetic pretraining delivers order-of-magnitude data efficiency gains, providing a new recipe reference for low-resource synthetic pretraining
summary_en.technical_approach: Replaces RDB-PFN's original synthetic generator with PluRel, designs a progressive single-table curriculum that gradually increases schema complexity from 7 to 17 columns, compares against random order and no-curriculum baselines
summary_en.experiments: On a 23-task tabular benchmark, achieves 0.703 average ROC-AUC with only ~13,300 synthetic tables (45x less single-table data than RDB-PFN's reported warmup recipe); same data trained in random order performs significantly worse

recommendation.zh: 表格PFN上验证合成预训练课程带来45倍数据效率，结论可作为LLM合成数据课程设计的弱信号，setup差异大无需精读，知道结论即可。
recommendation.en: Verifies 45x data efficiency gain from curriculum in synthetic PFN pretraining; weak signal for LLM synthetic data curriculum design, no need to read beyond the abstract given large setup gap.

paper.title: Self-Play Meets Skill Evolution: Self-Evolving Search Agents that Pose, Solve, and Remember
paper.abstract: Self-play agents can generate training problems without questions from target benchmarks, but their curricula lack persistent state: failures affect gradients yet do not explicitly shape future practice. External skill memories preserve procedural experience but are typically learned from fixed task distributions. We introduce \textbf{SESA} (Self-Evolving Skill-Augmented Agent), which makes procedural memory an evolving state of tool-augmented search self-play. A challenger poses problems, while

summary.core_problem: 要解决的是：零数据 self-play 的搜索型 agent 虽然能自生成训练题并用可验证奖励学习，但“经验是瞬时的”——失败只通过梯度影响参数，不会以可复用的形式显式改变后续练习；而 skill/memory 类方法能沉淀程序性经验，却往往来自固定任务分布，无法与自适应课程闭环耦合。论文试图把“自生成课程”和“可演化的技能记忆”做成同一个在线闭环，让失败能被提炼成技能并持续塑形后续 self-play 数据分布。
summary.importance: 对预训练/持续学习的启发点在于：它把“外部非参数记忆”从推理时检索增强，推进到训练时的状态变量（stateful training signal），让数据分布随记忆演化而改变。这类闭环更像 continual pretrain / online RL 的数据生成机制：不是只优化模型，而是同时优化“训练环境/课程”。不过它主要是 agentic RL + memory 的方法论文，对纯基座预训练 recipe 的直接可迁移性有限；更适合作为“自生成数据 + 可复用失败总结”的范式参考。
summary.technical_approach:
方法叫 SESA（Self-Evolving Skill-Augmented Agent），核心是把 tool-augmented search self-play 与一个有维护机制的技能库绑定成飞轮。
1) 角色拆分：challenger（proposer）生成带可验证 target 的问题；solver 用搜索工具解题并拿 reward。两者参数分离。
2) 非参数技能记忆 B：存“人类可读”的技能条目，每条包含：u（技能描述）、c（触发条件）、a（avoidance cues/反例与易错点）、z（可复用 query 模板）、m（使用统计：检索/有用/有害计数），并且是有容量上限的 bounded memory。
3) 非对称访问：solver 训练与推理可检索技能；challenger 看不到技能库，避免“出题方泄题/对抗失效”，维持不对称博弈。
4) 四阶段闭环：
- memory priming：用少量手写技能 + 早期 self-play 挖掘的去重技能初始化，给检索一个合理粒度与锚点。
- asymmetric self-play：solver 在 rollout 时检索技能参与决策，使技能影响 on-policy 轨迹，而不是训练后再加 RAG。
- frontier shaping：用某种机制把 challenger 推向 solver 能力边界附近（既不过易也不过难），让失败更“可学习”。
- failure distillation：从“信息量高的失败”中提炼技能，去噪/去重后写回记忆，并用 m 统计做维护（抑制噪声与冗余）。
5) 评估拆分 parametric vs non-parametric：训练后分别看 SESA-Off（关闭记忆，仅保留参数内化的收益）与 SESA-On（开启记忆，包含检索增益），并与纯 self-play baseline（SSP）对比，试图回答收益来自模型还是来自外部库。
summary.experiments:
论文给出的关键信息：在 3,125 道 held-out 问题、覆盖 7 个 factual + multi-hop search 基准上评测。
- 相对 SSP：SESA-On 平均准确率提升：Qwen3-4B +2.3，Qwen3-8B +3.2，LLaMA-3.1-8B +1.2（单位：百分点）。
- 相对 base model：分别高 +10.9、+7.0、+10.8（百分点）。
- 设计上强调 Off/On 对照，用来区分“参数内化”与“推理时检索”。（当前提供的全文片段未包含更细的分基准数字、消融表、技能库增长曲线、失败筛选准则的定量阈值等；这些通常是判断方法是否稳健的关键。）
summary.reading_guide:
泛读建议（约 25–35 分钟）：
- 先看 Method 总览图（文中提到 Figure 2 的 flywheel），把四阶段闭环与信息流（失败→技能→检索→新轨迹→新题分布）理清。
- 重点扫“为什么不能直接 self-play + skill bank”的论证段：噪声/冗余累积、challenger 泄漏、训练后加检索不改变课程，这是方法成立的必要性。
- 看 Off vs On vs SSP 的实验设置与指标定义：它决定了结论是否真能归因到“训练时记忆演化”。
- 如果要复现/迁移，优先深挖 failure distillation 与 dedup/maintenance 细节（什么叫 informative failure、如何判定 learnable、如何做 bounded memory 淘汰），这些是系统能否长期稳定的核心。

summary_en.core_problem: The paper targets a missing regime in zero-data self-play for tool-augmented search agents: self-play can generate its own curriculum with verifiable rewards, but the experience is transient—failures only affect parameters via gradients and do not explicitly shape future practice. Skill/memory-augmented RL can preserve procedural know-how, yet it is usually built from fixed task distributions. The goal is to couple both into an online closed loop where failures are distilled into reusable skills that then alter subsequent on-policy trajectories and the self-play problem distribution.
summary_en.importance: For pretraining/continual learning researchers, the main value is conceptual: treating an external, non-parametric memory as a training-time state variable that co-evolves with the data distribution, rather than a post-hoc inference-time RAG add-on. This is closer to online RL/continual pretraining where you optimize not only the model but also the curriculum generator. Direct transfer to standard next-token pretraining recipes is limited, but the design patterns (asymmetric access, failure-to-skill distillation, parametric vs non-parametric gain separation) are broadly useful.
summary_en.technical_approach:
SESA (Self-Evolving Skill-Augmented Agent) integrates tool-augmented search self-play with an evolving skill memory.
- Two policies: a challenger/proposer generates problems with verifiable targets; a solver uses a search tool to answer. Parameters are separated.
- Skill memory B: a bounded, non-parametric bank of human-readable skills. Each entry stores a description, trigger conditions, avoidance cues (common confusions/anti-patterns), reusable query templates, and usage statistics (retrieval/helpful/hurt counts) for maintenance.
- Asymmetric access: only the solver can retrieve skills; the challenger cannot, preventing strategy leakage that would collapse the self-play game.
- Four-stage loop: (1) memory priming with a small initial set; (2) asymmetric self-play where retrieval is active during training rollouts; (3) frontier shaping to keep generated problems near the solver’s competence boundary; (4) failure distillation that converts informative failed rollouts into deduplicated skills written back to memory.
- Attribution design: compare SSP baseline, SESA-Off (trained with the loop but memory disabled at inference to measure parametric carryover), and SESA-On (memory enabled to include retrieval gains).
summary_en.experiments:
Reported evaluation: 3,125 held-out questions across seven factual and multi-hop search benchmarks.
- Average accuracy gains of SESA-On over SSP: +2.3 (Qwen3-4B), +3.2 (Qwen3-8B), +1.2 (LLaMA-3.1-8B) percentage points.
- Over the corresponding base models: +10.9, +7.0, +10.8 points.
- The paper emphasizes Off/On controls to separate parametric internalization from non-parametric retrieval benefits. (The provided content excerpt does not include the full per-benchmark breakdowns or deeper ablations; those are important to validate robustness.)
summary_en.reading_guide:
Skim plan (~25–35 minutes):
- Start with the main method diagram (the flywheel in Figure 2) to understand the closed-loop information flow.
- Read the argument for why naive “self-play + skill bank” fails (noise/redundancy, challenger leakage, and why post-training retrieval does not reshape the curriculum).
- Focus on the SSP vs SESA-Off vs SESA-On protocol and what exactly is measured—this determines whether the claimed benefit is truly from training-time memory evolution.
- If you want to implement/extend it, spend most time on failure distillation + dedup + bounded-memory maintenance rules; these details govern long-run stability.

recommendation.zh: 值得扫方法图和 ablation；失败写回技能库这个闭环，比普通 self-play 更接近可复用 RL 数据引擎。
recommendation.en: Skim the method diagram and ablations; failure-to-skill memory write-back is closer to a reusable RL data engine than ordinary self-play.

paper.title: SDO: Structure-Aware Data Organization for Efficient LLM Post-Training
paper.abstract: Post-training of large language models is expensive, and existing efficiency improvements mainly focus on selecting informative samples or designing training schedules. However, data organization itself is usually treated as a static preprocessing step: embedding-based grouping methods construct fixed partitions before training and cannot adapt to the evolving sample exposure during optimization. As a result, all samples receive similar exposure despite their different optimization needs, leadin

summary.core_problem: 后训练阶段的数据组织通常是一次性静态预处理：基于 embedding 的分组在训练前固定，无法随训练中样本实际被暴露的程度调整，导致部分样本被重复更新、另一些样本欠优化，mini-batch 内还可能混入语义无关样本造成梯度冲突。
summary.importance: 属于 post-train 数据调度/课程类工作，对预训练研究的启发在于把 batch 组成从静态预处理变成带曝光反馈的闭环，并给出表示空间局部性与 batch 内梯度一致性的联系；思路对大规模 pretrain data mixture 与数据课程设计有一定迁移性，但实验规模和验证范围偏 post-train。
summary.technical_approach: SDO 在冻结的外部 sentence embedding 上运行，不需要 warm-up，也不改变学习目标和训练 schedule。epoch 内：对每个样本取 KNN，沿邻接图选 anchor 并把邻居聚合成 batch buffer，使 mini-batch 在表示空间上局部连贯；epoch 间：维护累计曝光账本，用随 epoch 单调上升的阈值重构 active pool，暂时降权过度曝光区域，同时保证覆盖。
summary.experiments: 在 SFT、DPO、GRPO 三种后训练范式上验证，均带来早中期收敛加速和准确率提升；梯度诊断显示 batch 内梯度更连贯，按题型的准确率更均衡。组件消融分别验证了 locality batching 和 exposure balancing 的贡献。论文未给出具体基座规模与绝对数字，主要以收敛曲线和相对增益呈现。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读，约 15 分钟。重点看方法图（Figure 1/2）和 KNN 遍历 + 曝光账本的两粒度设计；梯度一致性分析和三范式消融表值得扫一眼。若关心 pretrain 数据课程，可思考把 exposure ledger 推广到多源语料 mixture 的可能性。

summary_en.core_problem: Data organization in post-training is usually a one-time static preprocessing step: embedding-based grouping is fixed before training and cannot adapt to how often samples are actually visited, causing redundant updates for some samples, under-optimization of others, and gradient conflicts when semantically unrelated samples are mixed in a mini-batch.
summary_en.importance: A post-training data scheduling / curriculum paper. Its relevance to pretraining is the move from static ordering to a closed loop with exposure feedback, plus the argued link between representation-space locality and intra-batch gradient consistency. The idea could transfer to large-scale pretraining data mixture and data curriculum design, though the empirical scope stays within post-training.
summary_en.technical_approach: SDO runs on frozen external sentence embeddings, requires no warm-up, and does not change the learning objective or schedule. Within an epoch, it builds KNN neighborhoods, traverses the neighborhood graph by selecting anchors, and aggregates neighbors into a batch buffer so mini-batches are locally coherent in representation space. Across epochs, it keeps a cumulative exposure ledger and reconstructs the active pool using an epoch-dependent threshold that temporarily down-weights over-explored regions while preserving coverage.
summary_en.experiments: Validated across SFT, DPO, and GRPO, showing consistent early-to-mid convergence acceleration and accuracy gains. Gradient diagnostics indicate more coherent intra-batch gradients and more balanced accuracy across question types. Component ablations isolate the contributions of locality batching and exposure balancing. The paper reports results mainly through convergence curves and relative gains rather than specific base-model sizes or absolute numbers.
summary_en.reading_guide: Skim, about 15 minutes. Focus on the method figures and the two-granularity design (KNN traversal within epochs, exposure ledger across epochs). The gradient-coherence analysis and three-paradigm ablation tables are worth a quick look. For pretraining data curriculum, consider how an exposure ledger might generalize to multi-source corpus mixture.

recommendation.zh: 关注训练过程中的 data curriculum 和 batching 策略，提出基于 embedding 相似度和动态曝光反馈的 batch 构造方法，对优化 SFT/Mid-train 数据采样效率有一定启发。
recommendation.en: Focuses on data curriculum and batching strategies during training, proposing a batch construction method based on embedding similarity and dynamic exposure feedback. Provides some inspiration for optimizing SFT/Mid-train data sampling efficiency.

paper.title: DHRCL:Training Code LLMs with Dense Hierarchical Rewards and Curriculum Learning
paper.abstract: Reinforcement learning is a natural post-training paradigm for code-oriented large language models because generated programs can be evaluated through parsing, execution, unit tests, and structural analysis.However, existing methods often rely on sparse outcome rewards or statically combine heterogeneous dense signals, even though syntax validity, executability, functional correctness, and structural organization describe different and progressively dependent programming capabilities. We propose

summary.core_problem: 现有代码大模型RL后训练方法存在两个核心局限：一是稀疏结果奖励在多数生成样本失败时提供的引导信号不足；二是静态组合多种密集奖励信号，忽略了语法有效性、可执行性、功能正确性、结构组织性这些编程能力之间的递进依赖关系，优化目标与模型当前能力阶段不匹配。
summary.importance: 属于代码领域RL后训练的增量改进。其分层奖励设计和动态课程调度的思路，可迁移到预训练后期的能力递进训练、多目标训练信号的动态加权等场景，为预训练阶段的多目标优化调度提供参考。
summary.technical_approach:
提出DHRCL框架，包含三个核心设计：
1. 四层密集奖励体系：分别为语法有效性（容错解析器提取语法单元的有效占比）、执行成功（二进制运行结果指示）、单元测试通过率（表征部分正确性的密集功能信号）、AST结构相似度（与参考解的结构对齐辅助信号，不作为语义等价或代码质量的完整度量）；
2. 三阶段课程学习：按Syntax→Execution→Pass&Structural的顺序切换优化重点，阶段时长根据验证集性能趋势自动判定，无需手动设置语法或执行能力阈值；
3. 阶段感知的token级信用重分配：语法阶段按token置信度加权、执行阶段均匀加权、最终阶段按不确定性加权，将轨迹级奖励合理分配到生成序列的不同token。
summary.experiments: 给定的论文内容未包含完整实验章节。从引言部分可知，作者设计了三组对照消融：奖励组成（移除AST奖励的变体对比）、课程调度策略、token级信用加权方式，用于验证各组件对代码生成性能的独立贡献。
summary.reading_guide: 泛读重点看第2节Method的奖励分层逻辑和自动阶段切换机制，理解编程能力的递进关系如何转化为训练调度规则。预计阅读时间15-20分钟。实验部分可快速浏览消融结果，确认各组件的增益量级。

summary_en.core_problem: Existing RL post-training methods for code LLMs have two key limitations: sparse outcome rewards provide insufficient guidance when most generated samples fail, and static combination of dense reward signals ignores the progressive dependency between programming capabilities (syntax validity, executability, functional correctness, structural organization), leading to misalignment between optimization objectives and the model's current capability stage.
summary_en.importance: This is an incremental improvement in code-oriented RL post-training. Its hierarchical reward design and dynamic curriculum scheduling logic can be transferred to scenarios such as progressive capability training in late-stage pretraining, and dynamic weighting of multi-objective training signals, providing reference for multi-objective optimization scheduling in pretraining.
summary_en.experiments: The provided partial manuscript does not include a complete experimental section. Per the introduction, the authors conduct three sets of ablation studies: reward composition (comparison with a variant without the AST reward), curriculum scheduling strategy, and token-level credit weighting, to isolate the individual contribution of each component to code generation performance.
summary_en.reading_guide: For skimming, focus on the hierarchical reward logic and automatic stage progression mechanism in Section 2 (Method), to understand how progressive programming capabilities are translated into training scheduling rules. Estimated reading time: 15-20 minutes. Experimental ablations can be skimmed quickly to confirm the magnitude of component-level gains.

recommendation.zh: 分层奖励分解与自动课程切换的设计思路可迁移到预训练数据课程与多损失加权方案，重点看§3的奖励层级和阶段切换逻辑。
recommendation.en: Hierarchical reward decomposition and auto-curriculum switching logic are transferable to pretraining data curriculum and multi-loss weighting, focus on §3 reward hierarchy and stage transition mechanism.

paper.title: DomainPilot: Domain-Level Loss-Guided Two-Stage Data Mixture Optimization for Efficient Language Model Fine-Tuning
paper.abstract: The training efficacy of large language models (LLMs) is fundamentally constrained by the quality and composition of training data. Existing dynamic data scheduling methods face critical limitations in industrial-scale pretraining and supervised fine-tuning (SFT): data selection incurs prohibitive O(N) costs on terabyte-scale corpora, mixture optimization schemes introduce severe I/O bottlenecks or require training auxiliary reference models, and sample-level reweighting strategies rely on loss

summary.core_problem: 工业级 LLM 预训练和 SFT 中的动态数据混合优化面临成本高昂、I/O 瓶颈或依赖不可靠的样本级损失信号等问题，且现有方法难以无缝集成到 Megatron-LM 等主流训练框架中。
summary.importance: 提出了一种轻量级、框架无关的领域级数据混合优化方案，解决了大规模预训练中数据配比动态调整的工程和算法痛点，对提升数据效率和模型最终性能具有实际工业价值。
summary.technical_approach: 提出 DomainPilot，一个领域级损失引导的两阶段数据混合优化框架。首先，通过非侵入式补丁实现 Token 级的领域损失监控，在不中断训练的情况下捕获各领域的学习动态。其次，两阶段优化：阶段一利用领域特定的 Scaling Laws 提取先验信息（收敛损失、速度等）进行粗调；阶段二在粗调基础上进行 Mixing Law 扫描实验，建模跨领域交互，在局部范围内精调配比。架构上采用算法层与适配器层分离的设计，易于迁移。
summary.experiments: 在 Qwen3-1.7B 上进行验证。优化后的数据混合比例在不增加数据或计算成本的情况下，使模型在 LiveCodeBench v5 上提升 3.8%，BFCL v3 上提升 3.6%，在 MMLU-Redux 和 AIME24 上也有稳定提升。
summary.reading_guide: 重点关注 Methodology 中 Token 级领域损失监控的实现细节，以及两阶段优化（Scaling Law 粗调 + Mixing Law 精调）的逻辑。了解其如何通过少量代码修改适配 Megatron-LM 框架。预计阅读时间 20 分钟。

summary_en.core_problem: Dynamic data mixture optimization in industrial-scale LLM pretraining and SFT faces prohibitive costs, I/O bottlenecks, or relies on unreliable sample-level loss signals. Furthermore, existing methods are difficult to integrate seamlessly into mainstream frameworks like Megatron-LM.
summary_en.importance: Proposes a lightweight, framework-agnostic domain-level data mixture optimization solution, addressing the engineering and algorithmic pain points of dynamic data proportion adjustment in large-scale pretraining, offering practical industrial value for improving data efficiency and final model performance.
summary_en.technical_approach: Introduces DomainPilot, a domain-level loss-guided two-stage data mixture optimization framework. First, it implements token-level domain loss monitoring via a non-intrusive patch to capture per-domain learning dynamics without halting training. Second, a two-stage optimization: Stage 1 uses domain-specific Scaling Laws to extract priors (convergence loss, speed, etc.) for coarse reallocation; Stage 2 conducts Mixing Law sweep experiments around the coarse baseline to model cross-domain interactions and refine proportions locally. The architecture separates the algorithm layer from the adapter layer for easy migration.
summary_en.experiments: Validated on Qwen3-1.7B. The optimized mixture improved performance by up to 3.8% on LiveCodeBench v5 and 3.6% on BFCL v3, with consistent gains on MMLU-Redux and AIME24, without additional data or compute costs.
summary_en.reading_guide: Focus on the implementation details of token-level domain loss monitoring in the Methodology, and the logic behind the two-stage optimization (Scaling Law coarse tuning + Mixing Law fine-tuning). Understand how it adapts to the Megatron-LM framework with minimal code changes. Estimated reading time: 20 minutes.

recommendation.zh: 做 data mixture 的人可以看：它把 sample-level 选择降到 domain-level，方向对，但先别全信收益，优先看收敛曲线拟合是否真能稳定预测后续最优配比。
recommendation.en: Worth a look if you work on data mixture: the domain-level reduction is sensible, but the real question is whether the fitted convergence curves actually predict better mixtures rather than just smoothing noise.

paper.title: TRACE: Business Rule-Grounded Reasoning Curriculum for Knowledge-Preserving Parametric Tool Retrieval in Enterprise LLMs
paper.abstract: Parametric retrieval enables LLMs to retrieve tools implicitly by assigning each API a unique virtual token and training the model to generate it via constrained beam search. Toolsense shows that this regime has two critical drawbacks: it destroys parametric tool knowledge during training, and its beam-search decoding is too slow for real-time deployment. We introduce TRACE (Tool Retrieval via Augmented Chain-of-thought and Enterprise rules), a two-stage curriculum that resolves this dissociatio

summary.core_problem: 参数化工具检索方法在训练时会破坏模型已有的参数化工具知识，且依赖的束搜索解码延迟过高，无法满足企业实时部署需求。
summary.importance: 方法改进，提出两阶段推理课程训练方案，在保留工具知识的同时实现单束贪婪解码，降低部署延迟。
summary.technical_approach: 两阶段课程训练：第一阶段复用ToolSense的多格式记忆SFT，通过LoRA植入工具知识；第二阶段训练模型在生成工具token的JSON列表前输出思维轨迹，训练数据包含ToolSense的RRB对和基于领域专家业务规则合成的查询，均增强推理轨迹标注。
summary.experiments: 未披露具体模型参数量与数据集规模，以ToolSense为baseline，训练后保留了第一阶段的MCQ和QA探测精度，同时支持单束贪婪解码。

summary_en.core_problem: Parametric tool retrieval methods destroy existing parametric tool knowledge during training, and their beam-search decoding has too high latency for real-time enterprise deployment.
summary_en.importance: Methodological improvement proposing a two-stage reasoning curriculum that preserves tool knowledge while enabling single-beam greedy decoding for lower deployment latency.
summary_en.technical_approach: Two-stage curriculum training: Stage 1 reuses ToolSense's multi-format memorization SFT to seed tool knowledge via LoRA; Stage 2 trains the model to emit a thinking trace before generating a JSON list of tool tokens, using RRB pairs from ToolSense and queries synthesized from domain expert-curated business rules, both augmented with reasoning traces.
summary_en.experiments: No specific model size or dataset scale disclosed; compared to ToolSense baseline, the method preserves Stage 1 MCQ and QA probing accuracy while enabling single-beam greedy decoding.

recommendation.zh: 企业场景的工具检索SFT课程方案，思路可参考但通用性较弱，仅扫读摘要了解参数化工具检索的训练痛点即可。
recommendation.en: Enterprise-focused SFT curriculum for tool retrieval with limited generalizability; skim the abstract only to understand training pain points of parametric tool retrieval.

paper.title: Disentangling Curriculum Learning in NLP: Towards a Unifying Taxonomy
paper.abstract: Despite more than a decade of curriculum learning (CL) research in NLP, the field lacks a principled account of which difficulty function or scheduler to use for a given problem. To understand what has hindered progress towards this account, we propose a fine-grained taxonomy separating difficulty evaluation from training scheduling to enable systematic analysis of CL strategies. For difficulty evaluation, we distinguish attribution source and task dependence, revealing difficulty as a perspecti

summary.core_problem: 解决 NLP 中 curriculum learning 研究长期缺乏统一描述框架的问题，尤其是 difficulty function 与 scheduler 经常被混在一起，导致结果不可比。
